title: HOW TO FIRE DANCE. Samoa fireknife dancing Tutorials (Vili Kua)

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides detailed, step-by-step breakdowns outdoors while holding a practice fireknife. He encourages students with structured counts and demonstrates both traditional and modern variations.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and the training video.
Teacher explains the move Vili Kua (spin back).
Explanation of knife grip and positioning.
Slow counted practice of the spin.

cues: Every time the blade faces down

steps_taught.name: Vili Kua
steps_taught.description: Spinning the knife around the back with blade face-down counts.

what_works: Clear counting on every blade rotation
Showing both front and back angles
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between traditional and new styles without much pause

quotes.text: What I'm going to teach you guys is called the Vili Kua.
There's actually two different ways of doing the spin.
Every time the blade faces down, we're going to do a count.
